maya_product: Quick sync — starting a compact checklist for the "boarding checkpoints & autofallback" RFC. We need concrete launch gates, migration fallback options, and a customer-facing pin escape. Brain dump here, please reply with objections or additions.

arjun_ml: +1. Propose bench must pass: accuracy regression <= 1.5% on customer prompt set, embedding drift <= 0.025, p95 latency delta <= +40ms vs baseline.

sam_solutions: Customers will want explicit pin windows. Suggest: default auto-migrate after a 60d grace period unless customer opts into manual pinning. Offer a one-time 30d pin extension for enterprise.

liz_sre: From infra we need fallback chain spelled out: 1) route to same model in alternate region, 2) route to compatible smaller variant (quantized), 3) soft-degrade to cached responses + 503 with 'degraded' header if none available. Also add circuit-breaker thresholds.

arjun_ml: For model variants, require compatibility shim that preserves response schema and function-call hooks. If function-call outputs change > 5% we fail.

maya_product: Landing criteria we should publish: bench pass, migration playbook doc, comms draft, and SRE rollback runbook. Who owns the migration playbook?

sam_solutions: I can draft the customer-facing migration playbook + FAQ. Need clear language for opt-in vs forced migration, and a rollback contact path.

liz_sre: I'll own the rollback runbook and load-testing checklist. Need a staging canary at 1% traffic, metric burn-in window 48h, and automated rollback on error-rate > 0.5% absolute.

arjun_ml: Bench infra: I'll run the standardized suite against the candidate and baseline. bench_bot will post daily diff snapshots. For acceptance, we need two consecutive daily passes.

bench_bot: bench run queued for candidate v2.0 -> baseline v1.x. Results: https://internal.redwood/bench/1758888888. Current summary: accuracy -0.9%, embed drift 0.018, p95 +28ms.

maya_product: Good start. Action items: Arjun run two more daily sweeps; Sam draft customer migration guide by EOD Friday; Liz create rollback runbook + canary infra by Monday. I'll write the comms and policy for pin TTL (60d default, one-time 30d extension).

sam_solutions: Question — do we allow per-route pinning or only tenant-wide? Per-route helps PLG customers but increases bookkeeping.

arjun_ml: Technical note: per-route pinning requires catalog record + routing override; doable but adds state to the routing layer. If we need it, schedule as canary feature after the first migration wave.

liz_sre: Operational concern: per-route pins multiply cache shards and complicate KV cache warmup. Recommend tenant-wide for initial rollout.

maya_product: Decision: tenant-wide pins for v1 of this flow. Log the per-route ask as post-rollout enhancement. If critical customer requests it, Sam escalate.

bench_bot: Posted updated daily diffs. Next run in ~22h.

arjun_ml: One more: add a small synthetic suite of golden prompts for function-call stability — catches subtle signature mismatches.

maya_product: Agreed. Closing for now — I'll convert this thread into an RFC checklist and assign owners. Ping here with updates. :thumbsup:
